newsitem.title: CHINA: China executes 15 for theft after mass sentencing.
newsitem.headline: China executes 15 for theft after mass sentencing.

text.p: Authorities in China's central Henan province have executed 15 convicted thieves after a mass sentencing, the Procuratorial Daily said on Wednesday.
The 15 were shot soon after sentencing for crimes ranging from railway heists to car theft, the newspaper said.
Eight of the condemned had been members of two gangs that stole goods worth a total of more than 1.573 million yuan ($190,000) from trains between 1992 and 1994, it said.

Five were executed for stealing 133,000 yuan ($16,000) worth of valuables from industrial plants in Kaifeng city. The other two men executed were found guilty of stealing four jeeps, eight motorcycles and two bicycles, it said.
Other criminals sentenced alongside the condemned were given suspended death sentences, it said but gave no details.
China has executed more than a thousand people in recent months under its "Strike Hard" campaign aimed at curbing a rising tide of serious crime.
